_what: Trastuzumab baseline + HER2 epitope. Every score in this challenge is relative to trastuzumab, and the <70% CDRH3 identity gate is computed against cdr_h3 below.
_verified: DONE 2026-11-14 against the parent row of data/her2-trastuzumab/trastuzumab_her2_spr_all_768.csv on the VM. vh matches this file byte for byte. vl is now filled in from that row. The CDRH3 DID disagree and has been corrected — see cdrs_kabat.note.

sources: parent row of trastuzumab_her2_spr_all_768.csv (authoritative for this challenge)
vl.note: Constant across every row of both HER2 datasets — only CDRH3 varies in that screen.

baseline_measurements._use: This is the number a design must beat on the binding axis. For calibration: of the 190 SPR-measured designs in that file, only 12 beat it — a 6.3% base rate. Any ranker we build has to beat 6.3% in its top 4, and that comparison is the enrichment slide.

cdrs_kabat.source: Parent row of trastuzumab_her2_spr_all_768.csv, and the same 10-mer convention in tz_her2_facs_3classes_524346.csv.
cdrs_kabat.note: CORRECTED from WGGDGFYAMDY (11 aa) to WGGDGFYAMD (10 aa). Both datasets place the trailing Y in the framework: the VH reads ...YYCSR-[WGGDGFYAMD]-YWGQGTLV... USE THE 10-MER. Every variant row in both files is a 10-mer, so an 11-mer parent makes length-mismatched comparisons against 524k rows and silently breaks identity scoring.
cdrs_kabat._mutation_threshold: At the <70% ceiling on a 10-mer, 7/10 = 0.70 is NOT under the ceiling, so at most 6 positions may match: at least 4 of 10 must differ. (Same count as the old 11-mer reading, but reached differently — do not assume the arithmetic transfers if the loop length changes again.) Conservative 1-2 point mutants WILL be rejected.
cdrs_kabat._still_unverified: Whether abguard itself uses this same boundary. It numbers with immunum; if that yields IMGT or Chothia bounds the loop shifts again. Confirm against abguard once it is available on the VM — it was not installed as of 10:50.

contact_regions.source: 8PWH only — a domain IV loop not resolved in earlier structures; MD suggests it stays associated with trastuzumab

her2._use: De novo designs must be epitope-conditioned on these residues. A binder that hits HER2 anywhere else cannot compete with trastuzumab, so it can never be S-tier however tightly it binds. Use these as hotspots for RFD4-Proteina conditioning.
her2._caution: Residue numbering is for full-length HER2 including signal peptide (UniProt P04626). Confirm the offset against whatever construct the generation model and abguard expect before using these as hotspot indices — an off-by-22 (signal peptide) error here is easy and silent.
